table.unscored_outcomes: explicit unavailable, never coerced to failure
table.kind: derived comparison table, never camera observation

clip_selection.eligible: Matched valid pairs in the accepted comparison only. An invalid or missing arm excludes imagery from outcome-based category selection and remains visible in the all-mission table.
categories: first original-only SR success in declared mission order
first candidate-only SR success in declared mission order
clip_selection.absent_category: Show an explicit absent-category statement; do not substitute a more favorable mission.
clip_selection.fallback: Only if both discordant SR categories are absent: first matched valid same-SR-outcome pair in declared mission order. If none exists, show no paired imagery and state why.
clip_selection.sr_definition: Recorded upstream navigation success, not OSR and not physical touchdown.
clip_selection.camera: FrontCamera scene RGB only, original left and candidate right.
clip_selection.index_selection: For each selected accepted attempt, order observation.prepared by event_id. Assign zero-based decision index equal to the number of its action.completed records before that observation; require unique contiguous indices and the validated observation/action causal order, beginning at zero. These are derived decision indices, not a literal loop_index event field. Form their sorted intersection across arms. Select positions 0, floor((N-1)/2), N-1, preserving order and deduplicating repeated indices. Require exactly one observation per selected decision index and arm.
clip_selection.no_common_indices: State unavailable; do not align by nearest time or infer a missing image.
clip_selection.terminal_views: If either arm final recorded observation index differs from the final common index, append one separate side-by-side pair of each arm actual final recorded observation. State both indices and whether each corresponds to its terminal outcome; do not infer capture after termination.

mapping.alignment: Decision-index alignment only; paths, poses, host times and physical progress need not match.
mapping.time: Show each arm own elapsed host_monotonic_ns since its actual episode.start when both fields exist; otherwise unavailable. Do not substitute camera time with host or simulator time. Preserve all original time fields in mapping.
mapping.pixels: Use genuine copied PNG bytes with independent source receipts. A deterministic technical two-panel composition may resize each image with preserved aspect ratio but must not retouch scene content. Store both original hashes, each panel rectangle, caption and composed-image hash.
mapping.provenance: Retain full comparator output, both input analyses, selected attempt event chains, source hashes and every selected image mapping. Never invent unavailable actions, timing or candidate results.
mapping.presentation: Static editorial holds; not synchronized flight, continuous playback, original camera rate or policy rate.
